review_type: Internal adversarial source and regression review; not independent external certification

findings.title: Unicode values could become ambiguous in ASCII-only approval cells
findings.before: Non-ASCII characters were replaced with ?, while review coverage counted original characters. Distinct Unicode context or manifest strings could become indistinguishable.
findings.after: All TUI approval presentations escape before wrapping and painted-line accounting; literal backslashes double; expanded output over 1 MiB blocks approval; original operation bytes remain unchanged.

findings.status: fixed and validated with clean-checkout native candidate package
findings.title: Package source labels and unit-test claims were unchecked
findings.before: Caller-supplied SourceCommit and a preexisting binary were combined with an unconditional native-CI-tests claim.
findings.after: Clean HEAD and tracked regular package inputs are checked; unique fresh native build, exact version and copied-binary hash are required; metadata reports only actual packaging smoke checks. macOS tar also excludes host extended metadata and AppleDouble sidecars.
findings.limitations: Unsigned local source/build record; no publisher authentication or bit-for-bit reproducibility claim.

findings.status: fixed and validated by actual handler regressions and before/after native PTY runs
findings.title: Undersized export review could be approved without being displayed
findings.before: At width below 28 the renderer suppresses all modals, but export Enter checked only wrapped line count. A 20x100 terminal could persist a captured local snapshot without displaying its review. Four approval handlers also assumed 80x24 when terminal-size lookup failed.
findings.after: Export approval requires at least 28x10 and complete wrapped content fit. YAML/node, export, Helm and Copilot Enter handlers now fail closed on terminal-size lookup failure; existing mutation/session handlers already did.
findings.impact: Unreviewed private local snapshot persistence; no overwrite, remote mutation or arbitrary destination bypass was demonstrated.

security_boundary_test_environment: macOS ARM64; controlled loopback fixtures; serial test threads; no live Kubernetes writes or Copilot account requests
open_release_gates: Independent external security assessment and organizational pilot
Secure operational RBAC, admission policy and protected external audit deployment
Longer live-cluster and broad native-terminal acceptance beyond local evidence
remaining_model_limits: Same-user filesystem/executable replacement races are reduced, not universally excluded
Kubernetes subresource operations and native Helm writes retain documented name-recreation races
Known-field redaction does not classify arbitrary confidential custom data
Loopback forwarding is accessible to other local users
Long-lived watches have bounded caches, not a complete cluster-health guarantee
